To correct for this, I will expand the standard deviation to cover both a stall/reversal and a persistent upward trend.

Given the competing forces of strong recent momentum (+1.2 in two weeks) and very negative broader fundamentals, an SD of 0.8 points provides a roughly 68% confidence interval of -30.0 to -28.4. This adequately captures the likelihood of both a continuing rebound toward July baselines and a reversal back toward August lows.
